A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Ircambeat performs time variable tempo estimation and beat tracking, based on a time variable analysis of a set of features extracted from the audio.

we have developed a new beat tracker, called ircambeat, based on a novel beat tracking algorithm that combines the advantages of the best known beat tracking algorithms: 1) the ability of the autocorrelation method to track beats with a wide range of inter-beat intervals, and 2) the ability of a probabilistic method to track beats in the presence of strong local variations in tempo.
Ircambeat performs a robust estimation of tempo and beat positions in a time-varying way.
